name: Susanna Szljacsan — husband Joannes Janeczky and daughter Susanna
researcher_question: Who did Susanna Szljacsan of Lisková, Ružomberok, Slovakia marry, and did she have a daughter named Susanna, baptized about 1884?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 29, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-08-03: true match on content — the couple is corroborated by four further Lisková baptisms independent of the hint (1875, 1882, 1889, 1891) — but the identification of the mother as LDK6-6SH is probable, not proved, since no entry gives her age or parentage, no marriage record is indexed, and several same-named women appear in the parish. f3 requires the agent to qualify the identity link; that is the calibration point.
